items.heading: Adding ADA expertise to the SAFE STREETS Citizen Oversight Committee
items.action: Action: Moved to Action Calendar. 7 speakers. Mayor Ishii added as a co- sponsor. 1. Adopted Resolution No. 71,743–N.S. with paragraph 2 of the second resolved clause revised to read “SSCOC members from commissions shall be appointed by their respective bodies, and members of the public shall be appointed by the City Council as a whole. Members of the public shall be required to have a background in civil engineering, transportation engineering, infrastructure program management, or the implementation of municipal bond or tax measures. Council shall also strive to ensure that at least one member of the SSCOC has experience with ADA compliance and/or the accessible infrastructure challenges facing seniors and the disabled community.”; and 2. Adopted first reading of Ordinance No. 7,960–N.S. Second reading scheduled for May 20, 2025. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Bartlett, Tregub, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – O’Keefe.

added_cosponsors.as_printed: Mayor Ishii added as a co- sponsor
